criterion: Indian options expiry applies effective-dated settlement/exercise rules and preflights physical delivery inventory, cash, and margin without unaccounted delivery or margin deficit.
test_result: 9 passed across India expiry preflight, rule table parity, options settlement, durable journal restart, and stale-readiness checks; Ruff passed; targeted mypy passed; source inventory check passed (615 Python files).
evidence_scope: Synthetic contract-master, settlement-price, delivery-margin, and account data. No live exchange session or margin file is represented.
operational_limits: Official contract master, expiry, settlement price, and current applicable margin evidence must be supplied and source-attested by the authorized provider at run time.
The generic stock physical rule starts at the remaining-stock October 2019 phase. Earlier phased stock expiries block without contract-specific effective-date evidence.
The no-calendar-spread-offset expiry rule requires caller-provided margin evidence reflecting the applicable treatment; the module does not invent or independently fetch an exchange margin rate.
Pre-existing journal expiry events remain replayable for accounting continuity and are surfaced as legacy events without retroactive preflight attestation.
